title: Pairwise Coprime Nonrepresentable Integers for Two Coprime Bases
abstract: Let p > q ≥ 2 be coprime integers. Call a positive integer (p, q)-nonrepresentable if it cannot be written as a sum of terms p^i q^j for which no two distinct terms divide each other. Erdős and Lewin asked for which pairs there is an infinite sequence of pairwise coprime (p, q)-nonrepresentable integers. Yu and Chen answered this question except for the pairs (5, 2), (9, 2), and (5, 3). We prove the remaining cases. The proof works by creating a criterion for generating such sequences, which can then be applied to the three pairs.
